## 1. Reserved vs. Spot / On-Demand: When to Commit

### The Core Decision Framework

| Factor | Lean Reserved | Lean Spot / On-Demand |

| Workload is interruptible (batch, eval, rendering) | | ✅ |

**Almost every GPU family is in a rising-price regime.** The quarterly on-demand averages (Q1 → Q4 2026) tell the story:
